messages:
Sam CSG: Heads up — Centauri kickoff in ~48h. Customer opted for a reserved pool + autoscale. Need final thumbs on quota and burst sim plan.
Priya (CSE): Proposed quota: 200 vCPU-hours + 50k concurrent tokens baseline, with a burst window up to 2x for 15m. Customer expects short spikes; is that acceptable?
Ben (PSM): 200 baseline is fine, but confirm we actually reserve headroom for the 2x burst (so we don't silently throttle). Also suggest token-rate limiter at 10k/s per pool to avoid token storms.
Ava (SRE): From infra side: target p95 <= 180ms for single-shard runs. If p95 > 250ms for 2 consecutive minutes, automated rollback to smaller model + alert to #eng-oncall.
Jorge: I'll run the burst sim with our harness. Proposed pattern: 10k qps sustained for 10m, ramp to 20k for 5m, repeat 3x, then cooldown. Command I used in staging: 
```bash
./run_harness --target 10000 --sustain 600 --ramp-to 20000 --burst 300
```
Priya (CSE): Customer agreed to Thu 2026-03-26 22:00 UTC for the run. Need ops contact + KMS access confirmed before then.
Sam CSG: @Ava you'll be oncall for the first 2 hours after the run. @Ben can you confirm the no-cannibalization guard (no cross-customer stealing)?
Ben (PSM): Isolation policy 'dedicated_strict' is applied to the pool. Also added autoscale policy: scale up at 85% shard util, scale down at 30% sustained for 5m. Emergency throttle rule available.
Ava (SRE): I'll wire alerts: shard_util > 90% for 2m, token_errors > 1% for 3m. Alerts -> #eng-oncall + DM to me. I'll also add a dashboard tile for burst-window heatmap.
Jorge: Doing a quick dry-run against staging now with identical parameters. Sharing a short log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-23T15:12:02Z] init harness
[2026-03-23T15:13:10Z] sustained 10k qps OK, avg latency 120ms
[2026-03-23T15:18:45Z] ramp to 20k -> 1% 429s, backoff handled by client, no pool failure
```
Priya (CSE): Please attach those run artifacts to the onboarding folder (S3 path) and note any 429 patterns. Also create a 2-question feedback doc for the customer after the run (perf OK? any observed failures?).
Sam CSG: Follow-ups: @Jorge collect and upload logs + artifacts, @Ben confirm KMS rotation window won't clash with run, @Priya send customer feedback doc and run window reminder. I'll update the internal playbook with these entries. Please ack.
Ben (PSM): Ack. Also adding emergency fallback: if fallback-model invoked, reduce concurrency by 50% and spin an extra shard before scaling back up. That should reduce churn.
Ava (SRE): Ack. I'll be watching the metrics live and will post a short incident play if anything anomalous shows. :eyes: 
Priya (CSE): Ack. I'll have the customer complete feedback immediately after the run and share results.
oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC — isolation tag means no interference expected with dedicated pool.
Sam CSG: Thanks all. If the run passes, we'll mark onboarding as 'primed' and set renewal risk to LOW. If we see persistent regressions, we'll plan a follow-up run next week and flag as MEDIUM risk. :thumbsup:
